Bellevue’s transfer rules

  • Up to 97 semester credits from other sources can count toward the 127-credit degree.
  • At least 30 semester credits must be completed at Bellevue.
  • At least 30 semester credits must be upper-level.

Source: Bellevue University 2025–2027 Academic Catalog and Student Handbook (undergraduate degree requirements)

Pace used in this example

  • 2–4 completed outside courses per month is a planning assumption, not a provider promise.
  • 6–12 credits per university term is a planning assumption.
  • Outside providers are studied one after another in this scenario; overlapping study can change the elapsed time.
  • University loads use unit totals. Prerequisites, whole-course scheduling, start dates, breaks and registration availability can add time.
  • One-time university fees are included once; subtract charges you have already paid.

What this range leaves out

  • Uses the $459 online rate. The $250 military rate and Campus@Work or Guild funding are not applied.
  • Individual course fees ("Additional fees may apply for individual courses") are not included.
  • 6–12 credits per term (three terms a year) is a planning assumption.
  • Applicable sales tax on course subscriptions.
  • Books, supplies, course-specific charges and transcript charges when applicable.
  • Housing, meals, travel, health insurance and other living costs.
  • Rates are before financial aid, military benefits, scholarships, discounts and future price changes.
  • Completed or reported courses are excluded from new course charges; school acceptance of reported credit remains separate.
  • This is a range of known tuition, required university fees and selected outside-course charges, not a complete cost of attendance or a graduation-date promise.
  • Sophia uses the lowest published mix of monthly, four-month and annual memberships for the assumed study time. Prepaid plans require the upfront payment; promotions and tax are excluded.
  • 33 proposed outside units retain the eligibility conditions shown on their course rows.

Questions

Does Sophia Financial Accounting transfer to Bellevue University?

Sophia publishes this match: Sophia Financial Accounting for AC 205 Financial Accounting (3 semester credits). The match does not come from Bellevue, so ask Bellevue to confirm it before you pay for the course.

Does Sophia Managerial Accounting transfer to Bellevue University?

Sophia publishes this match: Sophia Managerial Accounting for AC 206 Managerial Accounting (3 semester credits). The match does not come from Bellevue, so ask Bellevue to confirm it before you pay for the course.

Does Sophia Macroeconomics transfer to Bellevue University?

Sophia publishes this match: Sophia Macroeconomics for ECN 201 Macroeconomics (3 semester credits). The match does not come from Bellevue, so ask Bellevue to confirm it before you pay for the course.

How many credits can I transfer into Bellevue University’s Bachelor of Science in Accounting?

Bellevue’s published limit for this 127-credit degree is 97 semester credits from other sources. At least 30 semester credits must be completed at Bellevue. This plan proposes 33 semester credits through outside courses.

Which courses must I take at Bellevue University?

In this plan, 94 semester credits are taken at Bellevue, including BA 232 Principles of Management, BA 252 Principles of Marketing, BA 312 Principles of Finance, BA 427 Managing Operations in a Global Supply Chain, BA 450 Business Ethics and BA 465A Business Law and 11 more. Bellevue requires at least 30 semester credits at Bellevue.

Can I choose my own courses in this plan?

Yes. 43 semester credits are open choices, such as Upper-level accounting electives (only one upper-level tax course: AC 433, AC 434, AC 435 or AC 439) and Integrative General Education Credits. You pick a course Bellevue allows, then ask Bellevue to confirm it counts.

How much does this plan cost?

The planning estimate is $45,993 to $48,593 before aid. It covers tuition, listed fees and the outside courses in this plan. It is not a complete cost of attendance.

Has Bellevue University confirmed this plan?

Not yet. Some course matches or open choices in this plan still need Bellevue’s confirmation. Questions to ask: Ask the school: what is the most ACE- or NCCRS-recommended credit you accept toward this degree? Ask the school to confirm 5 proposed course matches for this exact program before paying for them. Pick a course for 15 open course choices in this plan, then ask the school to confirm they count. Admission and your transcript evaluation are always Bellevue’s decisions.
